messages.content: In an anonymous one-shot interaction, A starts with 100 points and B with 0. A sends any amount from 0 to 100. Sent points are tripled. In the for-profit setting C receives 10% of the tripled amount before B receives the remaining 90%; thus the nominal amount reaching B is 2.7 times the amount sent by A. In the no-profit setting B receives all three times the amount sent, and C receives a fixed 10 points per pair from outside the pair. B then chooses how many received points to return to A. A keeps the unsent initial points plus the return; B keeps received points minus the return. C communicates before A and B act. C earns according to the stated payoff rule whether or not C sends a message, and C earnings do not depend on B returning money. A and B are told C payoff rule and see the actual message or its absence. They are not told the menu of preformulated messages available to C. Both parts of this study are paid, at $0.50 per 100 points plus a $0.50 participation fee. Predict the actual point transfer or return. Use one integer at the whole-point resolution of these records, with no explanation.

In the no-profit setting B receives all three times the amount sent, and C receives a fixed 10 points per pair from outside the pair. B then chooses how many received points to return to A. A keeps the unsent initial points plus the return; B keeps received points minus the return. C communicates before A and B act. C earns according to the stated payoff rule whether or not C sends a message, and C earnings do not depend on B returning money. A and B are told C payoff rule and see the actual message or its absence. They are not told the menu of preformulated messages available to C. Here C is always for-profit. This observer is not currently making A or B's transfer. Participation pays $0.50. Each behavior guess earns $0.15 if its absolute error is at most 5. For each shared-opinion statement the closest guess to the participants' actual mean can earn $1. Bonuses are calculated after the study, in about two weeks; no actual behavior or mean feedback is supplied between pages. On a current page several reports are submitted together; other answers on that same page are unavailable as prior history and entry order is unlogged. Report a numerical guess of the mean on the 1 to 7 scale, retaining up to one decimal place. This is a guess of participants' mean answers, not a direct personal agreement rating. Output only that number.

Bonuses are calculated after the study, in about two weeks; no actual behavior or mean feedback is supplied between pages. On a current page several reports are submitted together; other answers on that same page are unavailable as prior history and entry order is unlogged. Report a numerical guess of the mean on the 1 to 7 scale, retaining up to one decimal place. This is a guess of participants' mean answers, not a direct personal agreement rating. Output only that number.

In the for-profit setting C receives 10% of the tripled amount before B receives the remaining 90%; thus the nominal amount reaching B is 2.7 times the amount sent by A. In the no-profit setting B receives all three times the amount sent, and C receives a fixed 10 points per pair from outside the pair. B then chooses how many received points to return to A. A keeps the unsent initial points plus the return; B keeps received points minus the return. C communicates before A and B act. C earns according to the stated payoff rule whether or not C sends a message, and C earnings do not depend on B returning money. A and B are told C payoff rule and see the actual message or its absence. They are not told the menu of preformulated messages available to C. Here C is always for-profit. This observer is not currently making A or B's transfer. Participation pays $0.50. Each behavior guess earns $0.15 if its absolute error is at most 5. For each shared-opinion statement the closest guess to the participants' actual mean can earn $1. Bonuses are calculated after the study, in about two weeks; no actual behavior or mean feedback is supplied between pages. On a current page several reports are submitted together; other answers on that same page are unavailable as prior history and entry order is unlogged. Output one integer from 0 to 135, with no explanation.

For each shared-opinion statement the closest guess to the participants' actual mean can earn $1. Bonuses are calculated after the study, in about two weeks; no actual behavior or mean feedback is supplied between pages. On a current page several reports are submitted together; other answers on that same page are unavailable as prior history and entry order is unlogged. Output one integer from 0 to 100, with no explanation.

A keeps the unsent initial points plus the return; B keeps received points minus the return. C communicates before A and B act. C earns according to the stated payoff rule whether or not C sends a message, and C earnings do not depend on B returning money. For each shared-opinion statement the closest guess to the participants' actual mean can earn $1. Bonuses are calculated after the study, in about two weeks; no actual behavior or mean feedback is supplied between pages. On a current page several reports are submitted together; other answers on that same page are unavailable as prior history and entry order is unlogged. Report a numerical guess of the mean on the 1 to 7 scale, retaining up to one decimal place. This is a guess of participants' mean answers, not a direct personal agreement rating. Output only that number.

Bonuses are calculated after the study, in about two weeks; no actual behavior or mean feedback is supplied between pages. On a current page several reports are submitted together; other answers on that same page are unavailable as prior history and entry order is unlogged. Output one integer from 0 to 270, with no explanation.

On a current page several reports are submitted together; other answers on that same page are unavailable as prior history and entry order is unlogged. Report a numerical guess of the mean on the 1 to 7 scale, retaining up to one decimal place. This is a guess of participants' mean answers, not a direct personal agreement rating. A and B are told C payoff rule and see the actual message or its absence. They are not told the menu of preformulated messages available to C. Here C is always for-profit. This observer is not currently making A or B's transfer. Participation pays $0.50. Each behavior guess earns $0.15 if its absolute error is at most 5. For each shared-opinion statement the closest guess to the participants' actual mean can earn $1. Bonuses are calculated after the study, in about two weeks; no actual behavior or mean feedback is supplied between pages. On a current page several reports are submitted together; other answers on that same page are unavailable as prior history and entry order is unlogged. Output one integer from 0 to 135, with no explanation.

Bonuses are calculated after the study, in about two weeks; no actual behavior or mean feedback is supplied between pages. On a current page several reports are submitted together; other answers on that same page are unavailable as prior history and entry order is unlogged. Output one integer from 0 to 100, with no explanation.
